title: AI Agent与云基础设施深度融合：Serverless、数据主权与算力优化驱动云计算结构性演进
core_insight: 云厂商正通过AI Agent与底层基础设施的深度集成、Serverless快速部署及数据主权精细控制，系统性应对算力需求激增与合规挑战，推动云计算向智能化、精细化架构演进

dimension_texts.technology: Cloudflare通过Dynamic Workers实现AI生成代码的安全沙箱执行，速度提升100倍；AWS推出Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless秒级创建功能；Google Cloud推出生产就绪的AI代理构建方案与MCP服务器 微软Azure强化数据库AI能力，将AI直接集成到SQL和PostgreSQL体验中；Cloudflare推出基于AST的工作流可视化技术；AWS优化云原生基础设施体验 Sandboxing AI agents, 100x faster Advancing agentic AI with Microsoft databases across a unified data estate How to build production-ready AI agents with Google-managed MCP servers Announcing Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL serverless database creation in seconds A one-line Kubernetes fix that saved 600 hours a year New ways to migrate and scale Red Hat OpenShift on Google Cloud
dimension_texts.infrastructure: Cloudflare推出定制化区域服务，支持客户根据合规和性能需求自定义数据存储地理位置；AWS控制台新增可视化定制功能，提升多区域管理效率 Cloudflare Gen 13服务器采用AMD EPYC Turin 9965处理器，实现100GbE网络升级，计算吞吐量翻倍；ScaleOps融资事件凸显AI需求导致的GPU短缺和云成本上升问题 Launching Cloudflare’s Gen 13 servers: trading cache for cores for 2x edge compute performance Inside Gen 13: how we built our most powerful server yet Introducing Custom Regions for precision data control ScaleOps raises $130M to improve computing efficiency amid AI demand Customize your AWS Management Console experience with visual settings including account color, region and service visibility
dimension_texts.application: 微软宣布核能AI合作项目，将AI技术应用于核能行业；火山引擎推出短剧生产Agent进入内容创作领域；Salesforce展示AI代理在IT支持场景的规模化应用，40%案例由AI处理 微软推出首个端到端代理现代化解决方案，将IT和开发纳入统一工作流；企业AI应用从效率工具向创新引擎转变，Salesforce强调AI的战略价值超越单纯效率提升 AI for nuclear energy: Powering an intelligent, resilient future 接入Seedance 2.0，短剧生产Agent「火山剧创」正式邀测 How Salesforce Built, Tested, and Scaled Our IT Support Agents Many agents, one team: Scaling modernization on Azure Beyond Efficiency: How To Use AI To Innovate and Grow Manhattan Associates powers over a billion daily API calls with Google Cloud databases
dimension_texts.capital: 基础设施效率优化成为投资热点，ScaleOps获1.3亿美元融资应对AI算力需求；Strella完成1400万美元A轮融资，Amazon和Chobani采用其AI访谈技术 Uber收购Blacklane强化高端出行服务，显示SaaS厂商通过并购扩展垂直场景 大厂持续投资AI人才培育，AWS推出2026年AI/ML学者计划；微软与NVIDIA在GTC大会合作推进AI基础设施 ScaleOps raises $130M to improve computing efficiency amid AI demand Uber is buying Berlin startup Blacklane to bolster its 'Elite' offering Amazon and Chobani adopt Strella's AI interviews for customer research as fast-growing startup raises $14M AWS Weekly Roundup: AWS AI/ML Scholars program, Agent Plugin for AWS Serverless, and more Microsoft at NVIDIA GTC: New solutions for Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI infrastructure and Physical AI
